notes.title: Usurpator – Patch Notes Juli 2025
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35266443/413fbf595c614b2ad2a3fd3f7b249c3dbb0cb224.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Rune Sockets:[/b][/p][p]Locked Rune Sockets: Rune sockets that have not been unlocked yet are now displayed with a lock icon.[/p][p]Unlocked but Empty Rune Sockets: Empty rune sockets are now shown as empty, indicating they do not contain any rune.[/p][p]Rune Sockets with Runes: Rune sockets containing runes now display the corresponding icon of the rune inside.[/p][p]Visual Changes to Rune Sockets: Rune sockets now appear differently in the forging window compared to the weapon tooltip.[/p][p]New State for Rune Sockets: Rune sockets now feature an "IsAssignedUnpaid" state, which is visually highlighted.[/p][p]Rune Socket Effects: Existing rune socket effects now appear in gray, while newly added effects are highlighted in white.[/p][p]Weapon Highlighting: When runes are inserted into a weapon, the weapon is visually highlighted.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Forging and Weapon Enhancement:

[/b]Revamped Forge Window: The upgrade area in the forge window has been completely redesigned, making it clearer and more intuitive when unlocking rune sockets.[/p][p]Immediate Database Updates: Weapon upgrades and rune enhancements are now immediately written to the player database for faster response times.[/p][p]Enhanced Animations: Weapon upgrades and enhancements now feature an animation, smoothly hiding the server write process for a better user experience.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Crafting Improvements:[/b][/p][p]Ingredient Stacks: When crafting, ingredients are now considered across multiple stacks, making the crafting process more efficient and accurate.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Talent Points:[/b][/p][p]Unallocated Talent Points: If you have unallocated talent points, the talent icon will now be visually highlighted, and a notification will inform you that points are available to be spent.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p]World Map Fix: We broke the world map, but don’t worry – it’s fixed again![/p][p][b]– Your Usurpator Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Usurpator – Patch Notes June 2025
notes.content: [p]June brings a variety of quality-of-life improvements and new convenience features for all conquerors out there. Here are this month’s highlights:[/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//35266443/20c2dafc8fe9f99cf588a33014f0f4f042350b96.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 [b]Item Bar – Improved Handling[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Items can now be added to or removed from the item bar using [b]Ctrl + Left Click[/b] – quick and easy![/p][/*][*][p]The [b]auto-fill function[/b] for the item bar has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Only [b]usable objects[/b] can now be assigned.[/p][/*][*][p]Assigned items that are [b]not present in the inventory[/b] are now shown with [b]darkened icons[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips now support [b]holding the Alt key[/b] to display additional information.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚒️ [b]Forge & Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The [b]upgrade area[/b] in the forge window now also supports [b]Ctrl + Left Click[/b] – quickly assign or remove weapons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inventory slots[/b] now indicate an [b]"IsBlocked" state[/b] if the item is currently in use.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]"IsBlocked" state[/b] now also works for [b]stacks[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips in the [b]Forge Improvement window[/b] have been fixed and now support the new interaction hotkeys.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔊 [b]New Sounds for More Immersion[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Item Sell[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Item Buy[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Item Bar Drop[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Inventory Drop[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Forge Update[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Forge Improvement[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Equip Item[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🗡️ [b]Weapon Tooltips & Information[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Improvement rune sockets[/b] are now [b]always displayed[/b] in weapon tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]"Average Weapon Info Display"[/b]: Default view shows baseline stats, and [b]holding Alt[/b] reveals detailed values.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Stay sharp, Usurpers – and don’t forget to tidy up your item bar! More comfort, more clarity, more control – June delivers.[/p][p][b]– Your Usurpator Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: The Future
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35266443/103e1f6f8debe15339ac6218b97c45d38b3050b6.png[/img][h3]Hi everyone![/h3]

Our Kickstarter campaign sadly did not reach its goal, but we are not giving up just yet!
We plan to continue the development at our usual pace and hope to have an [b]Early Access[/b]
version of the game ready by [b]Q1 2021[/b]!

Both Sebi and I thank each and everyone of you, for the support and feedback you are giving to us. We have come a long way and seeing the community grow is what keeps us going!

So what is next, you ask?
- Well, here are the things we are working towards rights now:

[list]
[*] Create a coop adventure level, with an incorporated tutorial, so people have a better experience when they start with the game.

[*] Integrate the talent system, so classes can have different builds.

[*] Improve and expand the crafting system with new resources and items.
[/list]


There are many things, bugs and improvements we are working on too, but those are the main tasks we are chipping away at right now.
We will use this [url=https://trello.com/b/Q9JiqJtW/cor-roadmap]ROADMAP[/url] to show our general progress.

We hope you stick with us and help us test the upcoming patches so we get a good idea of how our plans are shaking out.

Regarding the demo we sadly have to remove it due to the running server costs.
We will think about how we are going to let people get access to the pre alpha, now that the demo is going offline, but this might take a few weeks until we have a good solution.

For all the pre alpha testers who already have a key, there will be a server up for testing purposes. We will host a playtest with a new patch every Wednesday going forward too.

So that is it for now, we will keep you updated!

Many regards
- Martin
